assumptions: GF(p^k) built as GF(p)[t]/(f) with the first monic irreducible f of degree k in lexicographic order
exhaustive over all (a, b) in GF(q)^2
meta.falsification: A linear model at an order that EXP-C05-03 found UNSAT or that EXP-C05-06 certified as a gap (would expose a bug); for H-C05-F, no linear model of any even order for 677 and 1313.
meta.hypothesis: H-C05-F: linear models over GF(p^k), k > 1, give spectrum members that the Z_n search of EXP-C05-05 cannot see - among them even orders for laws whose small even orders are gaps.
meta.methodology: Vectorised evaluation of (alpha, beta) for all (a, b); every model found is re-checked on its full table; comparison with the SAT statuses of EXP-C05-03 and the certified gaps of CLM-C05-08.
meta.question: For which prime powers q do the open laws of EXP-C05-03 have a linear model x*y = a x + b y over GF(q), and does this settle sizes that EXP-C05-03 left UNKNOWN or that CLM-C05-09 excluded?
meta.title: Linear models over finite fields GF(q), q <= 128, for the 15 open ETP laws

summary: 15 laws, 44 prime powers q <= 128; conflicts with SAT, certified gaps or the notes: 0
sizes n <= 10 left UNKNOWN by EXP-C05-03 and settled here: law 670 at n = 9 (not stated in the notes), law 907 at n = 9 (also stated in the notes)
